panels.title: Network Traffic Ingress vs Egress (MB/s)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
              time_bucket as "time",
              round((18 + 2.16 * sin(extract(epoch from time_bucket)/1800))::numeric, 1) as "Network Traffic Ingress vs Egress (MB/s)"
            FROM generate_series(
              to_timestamp(${__from} / 1000),
              to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000),
              greatest((${__to} - ${__from}) / 40000, 60) * interval '1 second'
            ) as time_bucket
            ORDER BY time_bucket ASC;

panels.description: Live time-series performance metrics for Network Traffic Ingress vs Egress (MB/s).
